0431| def resolve(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0432|     """Decide which single action one sentence asks for.
0433| 
0434|     ``kind`` is one of ``leave``, ``sensitive``, ``switch``, ``plan``,
0435|     ``clarify``, ``action`` or ``say``.
0436|     """
0437|     stripped = text.strip()
0438|     lowered = _normalise(stripped)
0439| 
0440|     if lowered.strip(" !.?,:;") in LEAVE_WORDS:
0441|         return {"kind": "leave"}
0442| 
0443|     if any(marker in lowered for marker in SENSITIVE_MARKERS):
0444|         return {"kind": "sensitive"}
0445| 
0446|     # A switch prefix may end the sentence, so the line is compared with a
0447|     # trailing space: ``switch to`` still asks for a project key.
0448|     padded = lowered + " "
0449|     for prefix in SWITCH_PREFIXES:
0450|         if padded.startswith(prefix):
0451|             key = _switch_key(stripped, prefix)
0452|             if not key:
0453|                 return {"kind": "clarify", "reason": "clarify_project"}
0454|             return {"kind": "switch", "key": key}
0455| 
0456|     if lowered.strip(" !.?,:;") in PLAN_EXACT:
0457|         return {"kind": "plan", "goal": ""}
0458|     for prefix in PLAN_PREFIXES:
0459|         if lowered.startswith(prefix):
0460|             return {"kind": "plan", "goal": stripped[len(prefix):].strip()}
0461| 
0462|     tokens = stripped.split()

0464|         name for name, words in ACTIONS if any(word in lowered for word in words)
0465|     ]
